$description: Palette and scale primitives. Raw values with no meaning attached. Application code must never reference these directly; use the semantic roles in semantic.dark.json / semantic.light.json.

ink.$description: Dark-theme neutral ramp. Near-black surfaces, warm-neutral text. Steps 6 to 10 are the text ladder; 0 to 5 are surfaces.

6.$description: Disabled only. Below AA as text by design.

cream.$description: Light-theme neutral ramp. Warm cream chrome, white cards. Mirrors the ink ramp step for step.

6.$description: Disabled only. Below AA as text by design.

red.$description: Brand accent, the only saturated hue in the core palette. Step 3 is the brand value and stays the accent everywhere it is decorative. Steps 4 to 7 exist so white labels on a red fill can reach AA, which the brand value does not (3.99:1).

1.$description: Tinted. Accent text on dark surfaces.

2.$description: Hover for accent-coloured text and icons on dark

3.$description: Brand red. Icons, borders, active indicators.

4.$description: Solid fill under a white label

6.$description: Shaded. Accent text on light surfaces.

gradient.$description: Stops for the brand gradient, taken from the logo. These are the one place the palette carries a hue other than the brand red, and they exist only to be interpolated between: nothing may reference them as a flat colour, which is what the no-primitive-token lint enforces. Two weights, for the same reason the red ramp has both a brand value and a fill value. Display is for marks and rules with nothing on top of them. Fill is for anything carrying text, and every one of its stops reaches AA under a white label where the display stops do not.

1.$description: Hot red. 4.28:1 under white, so display only.

3.$description: Orange. 2.85:1 under white, the stop that makes this weight unusable behind text.

1.$description: The accent fill, reused. 4.86:1 under white.

3.$description: Deep orange. 4.53:1 under white, the worst point on this weight.

1.$description: Tinted, for success text on dark

2.$description: Brand green. Fill and dark-theme graphic.

4.$description: Deep, for success text and graphics on light

amber.$description: Status warning. Extended palette, kept for functional warnings.

1.$description: Tinted, for warning text on dark

4.$description: Deep, for warning text and graphics on light

paper.$description: Brand cream insert. Used for the paper panel treatment, never as a UI surface.

space.$description: Six named steps on an 8-point grid. Pick the role, never the number. A value that is not on this menu is a design question, not a CSS decision.

tight.$description: Inside a control: icon to label

snug.$description: Between related elements in a group

compact.$description: Dense content padding: table cells, list rows, toolbars

base.$description: Default gutter: card padding, grid gaps

hairline.$description: The only border width. Separation comes from hairlines, not weight.

mono.$description: The machine voice: code, identifiers, versions, tracked labels

text.$description: Type scale. Dense by design: base is 14px, not 16px, because these are operator consoles.
